name: Moonglow Vest
summary: Moonglow Vest is a trade training task offered by the night elf leatherworker Lotherias in Darnassus. Overwhelmed by the constant needs of young adventurers heading into the wilds of Kalimdor, she trades the knowledge of a specialized night elven tunic pattern in exchange for bulk shipments of embossed leather gear.

sections.title: Equipping the Kaldorei
sections.body: In the sheltered boughs of Darnassus, tradesmen work tirelessly to outfit the swelling ranks of sentinels and aspiring wilderness scouts. As young night elves and allied wanderers venture forth beyond Teldrassil into a volatile Kalimdor, reliable armor is in fierce demand. Master leatherworkers like Lotherias bear the burden of keeping these frontiers supplied with sturdy hides.

sections.title: Mastering the Craft
sections.body: To ensure her apprentices possess both endurance and technical precision, Lotherias requires proof of their handiwork through multiple matched garments: embossed gloves, boots, and cloaks. Meeting this quota earns her trust, prompting her to impart the distinct night elven pattern for the Moonglow Vest—a garment favored for balancing supple protection with agile mobility.

faq.answer: Lotherias is a skilled night elf leatherworking trainer stationed in Darnassus. She oversees craft instruction for Alliance artisans and provides advanced designs to leatherworkers who prove their dedication.

faq.q: Why does Lotherias need so many leather items?
faq.answer: Darnassus is bustling with newly trained adventurers preparing to journey out into the world. Craftsmen are struggling to keep up with the continuous demand for field gear, prompting Lotherias to outsource standard embossed garments to capable apprentices.
The Moonglow Vest is an advanced piece of crafted leather armor. Its pattern is taught as a reward by Lotherias once you demonstrate your ability to manufacture high-quality embossed goods in volume.

faq.q: What materials are required to complete this task?
faq.answer: You must provide one pair of Embossed Leather Gloves, five pairs of Embossed Leather Boots, and five Embossed Leather Cloaks. All pieces must be crafted and delivered directly to Lotherias.

faq.q: Can Horde leatherworkers learn this pattern here?
faq.answer: No. Lotherias resides within Darnassus and strictly trains Alliance craftspeople. Horde artisans must seek out their own respective trainers across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms to expand their trade.

faq.q: Does this quest require a specific trade skill level?
aliases: when can i get moonglow vest
faq.answer: Yes, an artisan must achieve a leatherworking proficiency of at least 70 before Lotherias considers them skilled enough to take on the order and learn the vest pattern.

angles.text: The Moonglow Vest represents the elegant craftsmanship typical of Teldrassil's artisans, providing scouts and sentinels with agile protection under the forest canopy.
Outfitting fresh recruits in Darnassus helps maintain the Alliance's fragile hold across northern Kalimdor amidst growing wild and hostile threats.
